Negan is a fictional character in the comic book series The Walking Dead and in the television series of the same name  , who is the totalitarian and manipulative leader of a group called the Saviors. The Saviors coerce other survivor communities to give them their possessions and supplies through threats, force, and intimidation. What is the plot of  The Walking Dead series?

The Walking Dead is an American post-apocalyptic horror television series on AMC that is based on the eponymous series of comic books by Robert Kirkman, Tony Moore, and Charlie Adlard. The show follows a group of survivors led by Rick Grimes as they navigate a world filled with walkers (the living dead) and other groups of survivors. Throughout the series, the group faces various challenges such as finding food, shelter, and safety, while also dealing with the power struggles and conflicts that arise between different groups of survivors. There is also a  dangerous group of heavily armed men , who raid homes searching for supplies and weapons .
